citations.assessment: Heilprin’s Hana entry points to Avodah Zarah, which gives Hana Sha’ina or Hana bar Sha’ina transmitting R. Yohanan via Rabbah bar bar Hana.

holds.reason: Heilprin separately attributes the Rabbah pupil notice to Yuhasin in the Yohanan dossier. The Avodah Zarah passage names Hana and an intermediary transmitter, leaving the Rabbah pupil claim unresolved.

notes.text: Avodah Zarah supplies the named Hana tradition. The distinct Rabbah pupilhood claim remains qualified.
